title: Cross-process race through real 1v1 Discord Accept and Decline handlers
priority: P1 — the 1v1 Accept and Decline components must commit exactly one invitation decision when delivered concurrently by separate processes.

design.isolation: Temporary SQLite database with independent Node processes/connections; parent connection closes before races.
design.concurrency: Three synchronized races through handleDuelComponent: duel:accept for the invited player versus duel:decline, alternating the decline actor between owner and opponent.
design.clock: Deterministic non-expired time; both handlers use the same invitation revision.

assertions: exactly one real component handler commits and the stale competitor fails closed
the invitation revision advances exactly once
Accept winner produces a valid two-player DuelState, exactly two physical duel locks and a private success acknowledgement
Decline winner produces declined with null DuelState and releases the owner's physical lock
the public payload is validated through validateDiscordPayload and the accepted state's physical UIDs are unique
players, player_cards, starter_grants, decks and deck_cards remain byte-equivalent
limitations: Handlers/builders Discord.js reais executados offline com interações falsas; sem token, gateway ou guild real.
SQLite temporário e relógio determinístico; não mede latência de produção.
Nenhuma alteração de runtime, comandos, catálogo ou certificações.
